items.title: Securitize pushes into $6 trillion asset-backed finance market with River One acquisition
items.summary: The tokenization firm unveiled an acquisition and a $50 million stock buyback as quarterly revenue rose 13%. SECZ shares jumped 10% after hours.

items.title: Robinhood backs tokenization of its stock on OKX–ICE platform even as most companies opt out
items.summary: The brokerage firm said it would rather help build tokenized markets than sit on the sidelines, following a wave of early corporate pushback to the Intercontinental Exchange and OKX joint venture.

items.title: A Bitcoin block just neared a 2015 transaction record, but paid only $180 in fees
items.summary: The AntPool block came within 984 transactions of Bitcoin’s 2015 record, even as fees made up less than 0.1% of the miner’s payout.

items.title: Google’s AI chip push adds more pressure on Nvidia
items.summary: Google’s specialised AI chips threaten greater competition as Nvidia faces a leadership investigation.

items.title: North Korean hackers are creating memecoins to wash loot from $6.3 billion Binance hack
items.summary: North Korean hackers used six homemade memecoins to launder 117,000 NEAR, worth about $430,000, from the $6.3 billion Binance hack, Elliptic says.

items.title: NYSE picks Avalanche to settle tokenized stocks amid Wall Street's blockchain race
items.summary: Avalanche will serve as the core settlement ledger for the exchange's planned blockchain stock market

items.title: Solana set for its first tokenized stock venue under SEC framework, listing Galaxy
items.summary: Formation Securities plans to launch in early 2027 with Galaxy, Exodus and Forward Industries shares, expanding the U.S. regulator's experiment in blockchain-based stock trading.

items.title: Trump says he knows ‘nothing’ about World Liberty’s UAE ties as Justin Sun challenges filings
items.summary: Trump confirmed he co-owns World Liberty, whose UAE ownership could derail Justin Sun’s federal lawsuit over frozen WLFI tokens

items.title: Bitcoin bulls can't rely on ETF flows
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 9, 2026

items.title: Nvidia-led tech selloff weighs on crypto majors
items.summary: Only five of the top 100 cryptocurrencies by market value are up 1% or more over the past 24 hours. That is the state of the market today.

items.title: OpenAI builds kill switch to stop rogue agents within 35 seconds
items.summary: Control Room cuts off model output for internal research jobs when people or automated monitors flag safety or security concerns.

items.title: HIVE, MARA mine more Bitcoin but earn less as crypto prices fall
items.summary: Both miners reported higher Bitcoin production but lower mining revenue and rising electricity costs as they expanded their AI infrastructure businesses.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains?
items.summary: Some Australian crypto investors are moving overseas to avoid the huge CGT increase from July 2027. But there are also less drastic ways you can pay less tax.

items.title: North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic
items.summary: The blockchain firm traced stolen funds through six new tokens on NEAR, where hackers used liquidity pools to obscure transfers between wallets.

items.title: Formation Securities plans Solana stock trading venue under SEC exemption
items.summary: The proposed venue would offer 24/7 trading of tokenized shares from Galaxy Digital, Exodus and Forward Industries, with a launch planned for early 2027.

items.title: Mercado Bitcoin begins post-hack reopening without a timeline for withdrawals
items.summary: Customers can view their pre-hack balances as access returns in phases. The exchange has yet to say when withdrawals will resume.

items.title: PNC Bank tests turning USDC payments into dollar deposits
items.summary: The pilot lets eligible corporate and institutional clients accept USDC on Ethereum, with each token converted to one US dollar before deposit.

items.title: Avalanche’s AVAX leads crypto gains following NYSE tokenization deal
items.summary: Avalanche’s AVAX token rose as much as 10% after the NYSE selected its blockchain to support settlement on a planned tokenized stock trading platform.

items.title: Bitcoin, tech stocks brush off Nvidia nerves as analyst mulls $68K target
items.summary: Bitcoin rebounded from an 11-week low near $73,500 as the Nasdaq Composite rallied despite sell-off in Nvidia shares.

items.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.0 Are Impressive, But Be Prepared to Sell a Kidney to Afford Them
items.summary: Anthropic's latest AI can build complex software and even design physical objects. Users are producing impressive results, and estimated bills large enough to make developers wince.

items.title: AI Data Centers Are Buying Used Jet Engines as New Power Turbines Take Six Years
items.summary: A shortage of new gas turbines is pushing AI developers toward refurbished power equipment and jet-engine-based generators, even as high prices, pollution concerns, and permitting delays threaten their expansion plans.

items.title: Google Takes Aim at Nvidia With New AI Chips Built for Privacy and Massive Memory
items.summary: Google’s TPU 8tx protects sensitive AI workloads, while the dual-chip TPU 8i Max targets memory-hungry AI agents.

items.title: Binance Hack Launderers Mint Elon Musk and Animal Meme Coins to Move Stolen Crypto
items.summary: Elliptic says the hackers are minting their own worthless tokens—complete with cartoon animal and Elon Musk logos—and routing stolen funds through liquidity pools to break the trail.

items.title: Bitcoin in Limbo as Stocks Rebound Ahead of US Inflation Report
items.summary: U.S. stocks rallied as oil fell, but Bitcoin hovered near $75,000 after a wave of liquidations, with Tuesday’s inflation report set to test bets on a December Fed rate hike.

items.title: Nvidia's $350 Billion Scare: What Happens If Jensen Huang Leaves?
items.summary: Nvidia shares slid as much as 8% amid spy allegations. The stock was already weakening, and investors now face a bigger question: Who replaces Jensen Huang if he suddenly leaves?

items.title: Solana Set for Another Tokenized Stock Venue as Formation Notifies the SEC
items.summary: Operating under the SEC’s “Innovation Exemption,” the firm plans to list tokenized shares of Exodus, Forward Industries, and Galaxy Digital in early 2027, with the same voting and dividend rights as real stock.

items.title: Vitalik Buterin Moves On From ‘Ultrasound Money,’ Says ETH’s Value Is Stability
items.summary: The Ethereum co-founder says ETH's value comes from stability, not fee burns, citing its decentralization, censorship resistance and security.

items.title: Tom Lee’s Bitmine Adds $20M in Ethereum, Seizing on Vitalik’s 'ETH Is Money' Declaration
items.summary: The firm’s stash reached 6.07 million ETH—4.97% of supply and 99% of the way to its “Alchemy of 5%” goal—as chairman Tom Lee called Vitalik Buterin’s “ETH is money” comments a “seismic shift.”

items.title: NYSE Taps Avalanche to Settle Its Planned Tokenized Stock Platform
items.summary: Ava Labs said Avalanche will serve as the “core ledger technology” for the clearing firm behind the NYSE-affiliated venue, which aims to bring 24/7 trading, clearing and settlement of tokenized securities onchain.
